en.name: Database
en.description: One shared dataset with table, board, calendar, gallery and form views. Typed fields, filters, sorting, record details and Excel export.

zh.name: 多维表格
zh.description: 像飞书多维表格：同一份记录，表格、看板、日历、画廊、表单几种视图，点一条在右侧展开；字段有类型，筛选、排序，导出 Excel。

en.name: Table
en.description: A collaborative spreadsheet with typed columns, multi-cell copy and paste, fill down, sorting, filtering, search, and Excel or CSV export.

zh.name: 表格
zh.description: 像飞书表格一样一起填：列有类型（单选标签、日期、人员…），框选复制、从 Excel 粘贴、下拉填充，筛选、排序、搜索，导出 Excel 和 CSV。

en.name: Document
en.description: Write together with headings, lists, tasks, tables and code blocks. Each paragraph saves independently. Export Markdown or a web page.

zh.name: 文档
zh.description: 像飞书文档一样一起写：「/」插入标题、列表、待办、表格、代码块，选中文字改格式，拖动调整段落；每段单独保存，导出 Markdown 和网页。

en.name: Slides
en.description: Agents write content; the page arranges covers, points, charts, cards, tables and quotes. Co-edit and present; compatible Apps let agents export editable PowerPoint files and Markdown outlines.

zh.name: 幻灯片
zh.description: agent 写内容，网页按版式和主题排好：封面、要点、图表、数字卡片、表格和引言。共同编辑、放映；agent 可通过新版 App 导出可继续编辑的 PowerPoint 和 Markdown。

en.name: Meeting notes
en.description: Record your microphone and meeting audio separately, transcribe locally and identify speakers. Edit, search, replay and export transcripts; ask an agent for summaries, decisions and action items.

zh.name: 会议记录
zh.description: 录下在 Zoom、腾讯会议、飞书里开的会：你的麦克风和别人的声音分开录，会后在这台电脑上转成文字（不上传），自动分出不同的人；点一句从那里播放，改字、改名字、搜索、导出；让 agent 写纪要（总结、决定、待办、章节）。录音只存在这台电脑上，要在 myco App 里录音。

en.name: Learning workspace
en.description: Import a textbook, ask your tutor to teach at your level, and explore interactive diagrams and quick checks with source citations.

zh.name: 学习工作台
zh.description: 导入教材，按学习基础听导师分层讲解，边看原文引用、边操作交互图和做小题。

en.name: Code editor
en.description: A VS Code-style editor with a file tree, tabs, syntax highlighting, find and replace, multiple cursors and a minimap. Preview HTML or Markdown and download the project as a ZIP.

zh.name: 代码编辑器
zh.description: VS Code 同款的编辑器：文件树、多标签、语法高亮、查找替换、多光标、小地图；agent 直接写文件，你在里面改；HTML 和 Markdown 能直接预览，整个项目能下载成 zip。

en.name: Issue tracker
en.description: Track issues and projects with IDs, statuses, priorities, assignees and labels. Use list or board views and keyboard commands; assign work to agents and see their updates.

zh.name: 任务追踪
zh.description: 像 Linear 那样管问题和项目：编号、状态、优先级、负责人、标签，列表和看板，键盘就能操作；问题可以指给 agent，它改状态、写评论，你这边马上看到。

en.name: Developer toolbox
en.description: JSON, Base64, URL encoding, hashes, timestamps, UUIDs, JWT inspection, regex, text diff, naming, number bases and colors. Everything runs locally; saved tools are shared.

zh.name: 开发者工具箱
zh.description: 常用小工具一页搞定：JSON 格式化、Base64、URL 编解码、MD5 和 SHA、时间戳、UUID、JWT 解析、正则测试、文本对比、命名、进制和颜色转换；全在本地算，收藏的大家都能用。

en.name: To-do list
en.description: A shared list with due dates, assignees, notes, importance and drag ordering. Add tasks with Enter or ask an agent to organize your action items.

zh.name: 待办清单
zh.description: 一起记的待办：回车就加，认得「明天」「周五」「@名字」「!」；打勾完成，截止、负责人、备注，拖动排序；agent 能把会议里的待办整理进来。

en.name: Notes
en.description: Nested pages with rich text, icons, covers, favorites, search and trash. Write with slash commands, organize your ideas and work with agents on shared pages.

zh.name: 笔记
zh.description: 像 Notion 一样记笔记：左边是一层层的页面，每页有图标、封面和标题，「/」插入标题、列表、待办、表格、代码块；搜索、收藏、回收站；agent 能建页面、往页面里写东西，你这边实时看到。

en.name: Disk cleanup
en.description: Explore disk and folder usage, find large files and move selected items to Trash. Scans run on this computer; files can be restored until Trash is emptied.

zh.name: 空间清理
zh.description: 看清这台电脑的磁盘被谁占了：一圈一圈的占用图，旁边是按大小排的清单，点进文件夹一层层往下看；把不要的拖进「待清理」，看一眼再移进废纸篓，放错了还能放回去。要在 myco App 里打开。

en.name: Stock watch
en.description: Follow A-shares, Hong Kong and US stocks in one workspace. Share watchlists and notes, inspect candlesticks, volume and moving averages, and switch market data providers or use your own gateway.

zh.name: 行情工作台
zh.description: 在同一个工作台关注 A 股、港股、美股：共享自选与观察笔记，查看日周月 K 线、成交量和均线，导出行情。数据源可切换，支持接入自己的行情网关；行情由打开应用的电脑获取。

en.name: Proxy console
en.description: Manage an existing local Mihomo or sing-box core: traffic, policies, node delay, connections and configuration summaries. Credentials stay local. Requires Clash API and a desktop App with proxy controller support.

zh.name: 代理工作台
zh.description: 管理本机 Mihomo 与 sing-box：实时流量、策略组切换、节点测速、连接查看与断开、运行配置摘要。控制密钥留在本机，不与工作区共享。需启用内核 Clash API，并使用支持 proxy.profile 的桌面 App。

en.name: Budget book
en.description: Track income, expenses, balance and monthly budgets together. Review categories and daily entries, or ask an agent to organize your bills.

zh.name: 记账本
zh.description: 记收入和支出：每月支出、收入、结余和预算剩余，按分类看钱花在哪，按天列出每一笔；家里或小团队一起记，agent 能把账单整理进来。

en.name: Habit tracker
en.description: Build habits together. Check in each day, follow weekly progress and streaks, and see how family or teammates are doing.

zh.name: 习惯打卡
zh.description: 一起养成好习惯：每人给自己打卡，看这周打了几天、连续了几天、别人打了没；家人、团队一起坚持，agent 能帮你提醒和统计。

en.name: Logo Studio
en.description: Turn a brand brief into original geometric marks with your agent. Compare concepts, inspect guides, edit vector layers and export SVG.

zh.name: 标志工坊
zh.description: 输入品牌需求，请 agent 设计原创几何标志。比较不同方案、查看构图辅助线、微调矢量图层，再导出 SVG。

en.name: Design studio
en.description: Design websites, interfaces, posters and dashboards with agents. Edit canvases and layers, preview HTML, collect feedback and save versions; compatible Apps let agents export shared SVG, PNG, HTML or JSON files.

zh.name: 设计工作台
zh.description: 和 agent 一起设计网页、界面、海报和数据看板。可编辑画布与图层，预览 HTML，收集反馈并保存版本；agent 可通过新版 App 导出共享作品的 SVG、PNG、HTML 或 JSON。

en.name: Whiteboard
en.description: An infinite canvas with sticky notes, text, shapes and connectors. Co-edit with agents and export SVG/PNG; compatible Apps let agents export shared boards in the background.

zh.name: 白板
zh.description: 一块无限大的画布：便签、文字、形状和连线。和 agent 共同编辑，导出 SVG/PNG；兼容新版 App 时，agent 可在后台导出共享白板。

en.name: Mind map
en.description: Organize ideas as topics and branches. Edit, fold, reorder and drag topics, collaborate with agents, and export an outline or image.

zh.name: 思维导图
zh.description: agent 写一份大纲，网页画成思维导图；Tab 加子主题、Enter 加同级、拖动换位置、折叠分支，导出 Markdown 大纲。

en.name: Video editor
en.description: Import video, split and trim clips, change speed, add text and mask faces or number plates. Export MP4 locally. Media stays on this computer; the edit plan is shared with people and agents.

zh.name: 视频剪辑
zh.description: 导入 mp4，在时间线上分割、裁剪、调顺序、变速，加文字，给人脸和车牌打模糊或马赛克，在本机导出 mp4。视频只存在打开它的电脑上，剪辑方案大家共用，agent 按备注帮你剪。

en.name: Motion video
en.description: Make product promos, data stories and vertical shorts with motion: start from a template and change the words, pictures and colours, or ask an agent to write every scene (HTML with animation). Leave notes on moments for the agent, or have it remake a reference video; add music and voice, cut on the beat, turn speech into captions, save templates for everyone, and export an MP4 on this computer.

zh.name: 动效视频
zh.description: 做产品宣传、数据快报、竖版短视频这类动效视频：从模板开始改文字、图片和配色，或者说一句话让 agent 写好每个场景（HTML 加动画）；在时间点上批注让 agent 改，照一段参考视频重做；配上音乐和配音，场景切换对上节拍，配音转成字幕；存成模板给大家用；在本机导出 mp4。

en.name: Photo editor
en.description: Crop, adjust colors, filter, retouch, add text or stickers, draw, mask and frame your photos. Originals stay local; share edit instructions and undo any change.

zh.name: 修图
zh.description: 快速修照片：裁剪旋转、调色、十几种滤镜、磨皮美白、文字、贴纸、涂鸦、马赛克、边框，按住对比原图，导出 JPG 或 PNG。改了随时能退回去；照片只存在打开它的电脑上，修了什么大家都看得到，agent 也能按你说的帮你调。

en.name: Arcade Emulator
en.description: Play local NES cartridges and CHIP-8 games with touch controls, or verify and launch arcade ROM ZIPs with MAME in the desktop App.

zh.name: 街机模拟器
zh.description: 导入本机 NES 卡带或玩 CHIP-8 游戏，支持触屏手柄。桌面 App 还可调用 MAME 校验并运行街机 ROM ZIP。

en.name: Voyage
en.description: Take a small boat out on a lifelike 3D sea and explore freely: waves, shallows, reefs and islands are drawn live on this computer. Islands are page data that people and agents can add, so the map keeps growing.

zh.name: 航海
zh.description: 开一条小船，在逼真的 3D 海上自由探索：浪、浅滩、礁石和海岛都在本机实时画出来。岛是页面里的数据，人和 agent 都能加，地图可以一直往外扩。

en.name: Gomoku
en.description: Play five-in-a-row with another person or an agent. Choose black or white, take turns, undo moves, resign or start a new round.

zh.name: 五子棋
zh.description: 和同事或 agent 下一局五子棋：谁执黑谁执白随便坐，网页管轮次、判输赢，能悔棋、认输、再来一局。

en.name: Sudoku
en.description: Solve a puzzle together. Each cell saves separately with the player's color, conflicts are highlighted, and easy, medium or hard puzzles have one solution.

zh.name: 数独
zh.description: 大家一起填一道数独：每格单独保存，谁填的显示谁的颜色，冲突标红；简单、中等、困难三档新题，每道只有一个答案。

en.name: Remote Desktop
en.description: View and control your Mac and Windows computers from a computer or iPhone. Phone touchpad and keyboard, optional hosting component and temporary pairing codes. Direct LAN or Tailscale; no audio, lock screens or public relay yet.

zh.name: 远程桌面
zh.description: 从电脑或 iPhone 连接同一工作区的 Mac 与 Windows，实时查看画面、操作键鼠。手机支持触控板和键盘；远控组件按需安装，默认关闭。局域网或 Tailscale 直连，暂不含声音、锁屏登录和公网中继。

en.name: Recording studio
en.description: Record your screen, trim and split clips, add text and focus zooms, then export MP4 locally. Footage stays on your computer; agents can help with the edit.

zh.name: 录屏工作台
zh.description: 录下屏幕，直接裁剪、分割、加文字和重点放大，在本机导出 MP4。视频留在本机，剪辑方案可以交给 agent 协作。

en.name: Cinema
en.description: Watch movies and series from your own sources. Search catalogs, choose episodes, share a watchlist and resume locally, with playback speed and intro/outro skipping. No sources are bundled.

zh.name: 影视
zh.description: 用自己的影视源搜索电影与剧集、选集播放，收藏待看清单；观看进度保存在这台电脑，支持续播、倍速和跳过片头片尾。不内置影视源。

en.name: Calendar
en.description: Plan work and life in month, week and day views. Click to create events, drag to reschedule, add all-day and recurring events, search and export calendars with agents. Appointment booking is a secondary tool.

zh.name: 日历
zh.description: 管理自己的工作与生活日程：月、周、日视图，点击日期新建，拖动改期，全天与重复日程，搜索和日历导出。与 agent 一起安排；预约管理放在次级入口。

en.name: Personality explorer
en.description: Explore four preference pairs with 32 original questions, read 16 perspectives and keep a private reflection journal. Answers stay on your device; choose to share a summary with agents. Not the official MBTI® assessment.

zh.name: 人格探索
zh.description: 用 32 个原创小问题探索四维人格偏好，阅读 16 种可能，写下自我反思。答案仅留在本机，主动分享摘要后可与 agent 一起讨论。非官方 MBTI® 测评。

en.name: Reader
en.description: A local bookshelf for PDF and TXT books. Choose page transitions, paper themes and typography; keep your place with contents, search and bookmarks. Original files stay on this device.

zh.name: 阅读
zh.description: 你的本机书架：导入 PDF 和 TXT，享受多种翻页效果、阅读主题与自由排版。目录、搜索、书签和阅读进度随手可用；原书保存在本机。

en.name: World Podcasts
en.description: Turn a 3D globe to discover public podcasts by region. Search, listen continuously, follow shows, like episodes, change speed and set a sleep timer. Progress stays on this device. Requires a native App with network media streaming.

zh.name: 地球播客
zh.description: 转动3D地球，点选地区频道发现公开播客。支持搜索、连续收听、喜欢、订阅、倍速、睡眠定时与本机续听。需支持网络媒体流的新版 App。

en.name: Shopping comparison
en.description: Connect the Maishou product API for direct agent queries of offers, discounts and purchase links, with sources and query times. Save offers and shared buying notes. Requires your own Maishou credentials configured on the executing agent.

zh.name: 购物比价
zh.description: 对接买手商品 API，由 agent 直接查询报价、优惠与购买链接，保留来源和查询时间。支持收藏与购买笔记；需在执行端配置自己的买手授权凭证，开通后使用。

en.name: AIGC Canvas
en.description: Connect notes, text, images, and videos into workflows, run them with your own provider keys, and share nodes and results.

zh.name: AIGC 画布
zh.description: 把便签、文本、图片和视频连成工作流，使用自己的生成服务密钥，与协作者共享节点和结果。

en.name: Color studio
en.description: Extract colors from images, create and save palettes, explore color harmonies, and check text contrast. Share design notes with your team and agent; export SVG, CSS and JSON.

zh.name: 配色助手
zh.description: 从图片提色，生成、调整与收藏配色方案，分析文字对比度，预览实际设计搭配。与团队和 agent 共享色卡及设计笔记，支持 SVG、CSS、JSON 导出。
